Cryptography

Голосование по управлению

A formal process in which token holders or delegates participate in the decision-making of a protocol or DeFi platform, influencing upgrades, parameters, or resource allocation through on-chain or off-chain ballots.

Definition

A formal process in which token holders or delegates participate in the decision-making of a protocol or DeFi platform, influencing upgrades, parameters, or resource allocation through on-chain or off-chain ballots.

Operational example

Participating in governance votes enables portfolio managers to influence protocol upgrades, fee structures, and incentive distributions in DeFi ecosystems.
